claimChecks.assessment: The Remote Upgrader prerequisite table names Windows Server 2012 R2 for its own host. The exact 10.4 and 10.6 Windows package matrices both omit it and explicitly say unlisted operating-system and architecture combinations are unavailable. The comparison now records that exclusion for both UF and HF. The 2016 row differs by release: 10.4 lists availability for UF and 10.6 lists planned removal for UF. Both leave the Enterprise package cell blank. Fleet workflow and unlisted older target versions remain open.
